name: EPIC 211825181
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 16, 11.3 solar radii and 1.22 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 6,445 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 1.22 solar masses and 11.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,167 K at its surface.
